verdicts.title: Analysis of Titles and Readers For Title Generation Centered on the Readers
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The title of a document has two roles, to give a compact summary and to lead the reader to read the document. verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Missing web pages, URIs that return the 404 "Page Not Found" error or the HTTP response code 200 but dereference unexpected content, are ubiquitous in today's browsing experience.
